function.name: musicCharts_getMostPlayed
function.description: This function retrieves the most played song in a particular genre from a specified region Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

genre.description: Music genre e.g., Rock, Pop, HipHop etc.

region.description: Region where the song popularity is to be checked

duration.description: Time duration in hours for which the music played count will be considered. default is 0

message.reasoning: The user asks: "目前最受歡迎的流行歌曲是什麼？還請幫我找出澳洲目前最受歡迎的搖滾歌曲。" They want the most popular pop song currently (global?) and also the most popular rock song in Australia. We need to use the function to get the most played song in a particular genre from a specified region. For pop globally, region unspecified? The function requires region. We can use "global" or "world". For rock in Australia, region "Australia". So we need to call function twice: one for pop globally, one for rock in Australia. The function signature: musicCharts_getMostPlayed({genre, region, duration?}). We'll call with duration maybe default 0. So first call: genre: "Pop", region: "Global" or "World". The function might accept "world" or "global". We'll use "world". Second call: genre: "Rock", region: "Australia". Then we need to respond with the results. The function returns any; we need to interpret. We'll just output the results.
